properties.summary: Uzbekistan (UZ): 74.1% connectivity drop (BGP -0.1%, active probing -0.2%, darknet -74.1%) over 11 h, against the same hours of the 7 days before. z-score -3.77 against the same 7 days. BGP held steady, so this reads as a single-source dip (BO-IND-4), not a confirmed outage. Other measurers in this country within 24 h: Cloudflare Radar 0 outages and 0 verified anomalies; NetBlocks 0 posts. Percent of normal: IODA active probing at 99.8% of its usual level for these hours. Exposure, an upper bound and not users affected: about 33 million people online in Uzbekistan (ITU 2024: 89.5% of 36 million). Access Now's STOP sheet lists no shutdown in this country in 2025; context only, not evidence about this outage.
properties.title: Uzbekistan: single-signal dip, 74.1% (merit-nt)
